We've got three routine cargo aircraft — Airlift-1, Airlift-2, and Airlift-3 — arriving tomorrow morning, and three ramp windows available: 0900-1000, 1100-1230, and 1300-1500. Standard procedure is to assign ramp windows in manifest order unless we have confirmed operational constraints. Aviation liaison, S-4 logistics — do either of you have any constraints I need to be aware of before I publish the ramp board?
